name: Chengjiang Fossil Site
description: In the hills of Yunnan province, southwest China, this 512-hectare site holds fossils from 530 million years ago, when most of today's major animal groups burst onto the scene. Remarkably, even soft tissues survive, so you can see the anatomy of about 196 species, from early vertebrates to strange creatures with no modern relatives. It captures an ancient seafloor community in extraordinary detail.
